design: Prospective exploratory paired study with published existing doctor reports; no live clinicians; report assertion concordance is not clinically adjudicated accuracy
clinical_context: Modality only, no history or priors; all views of one patient study
gpt_identity: Requested native provider identifier verified per trace; backend weights/revision not exposed

medgemma_serving.system_context: Expert research imaging interpreter; only final supplied case user message and its images, excludes platform startup greeting
medgemma_serving.generation_prefill: <unused95> final channel, selected on development only
medgemma_serving.output_channel_handling: Return final channel after unused95 marker, retain complete generated text privately

medgemma_27b: Not run: 8 GiB device cannot execute pinned full multimodal model in this bounded setup
input_B: CXR all 1-2 released views; CT 16 uniform 5-95% axial slices, lung and mediastinal windows, four montages; MRI up to four lexical sequence-family representatives with 12 uniform axial slices each
input_A: All released images from selected volume/study converted with audited geometry to derived DICOM in Weasis; screenshot evidence only; not necessarily complete original exam

cost_ceiling.authorized_allowance: Existing Codex Pro plus one existing free banked reset; Check balance and allowance before each provider start; one existing free reset at 95% usage preserves headroom; stop at 95% after reset or any observed credit draw; shared account contention cannot be guaranteed absent
cost_ceiling.currency_prices: Unavailable for subscription usage; no invented dollar comparisons

references: Pre-output frozen explicit report clause assertions; uncertain/conflicting/redacted assertions ambiguous, omitted findings unscorable; no model-based correctness judge
CXR_sampling: Report-enriched 40 candidate-positive and 20 explicit-all-four-negative studies; quota 10 each target candidate positive, labels overlap, conservative audited assertions can remove candidate positivity; not population prevalence or predictive-value estimate
reference_limitations: OpenI released patient reports treated as study identities without external longitudinal linkage
CT reports translated by dataset authors
MR reports translated/restructured using Qwen by dataset authors; sparse assertions and no target negatives
Source studies may omit original clinical sequences
metrics: Per-modality, per-label report concordance; Wilson 95% binomial intervals; completed-only confusion plus all-assigned failure denominator and missing-outcome bounds; patient-paired difference bootstrap 5000 with seed graysby-paired-bootstrap-v1, exact McNemar exploratory; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims
confidence: Confidence refers to primary conclusion; no adjudicated primary-diagnosis gold, so Brier/ECE/AUROC calibration not estimable. Descriptive confidence only.
roles: Delegated tool supplies cached independent blinded MedGemma B read before primary answer. Second-reader supplies saved primary B and same independent MedGemma B read in a fresh context. Self-review supplies saved primary B only. Shared cached reads counted once physically; per-configuration consult overhead stated separately. No targeted follow-up tool.
repeat_policy: One prospectively selected fresh independent context repeat; do not inflate primary sample N
fresh_policy: Prespecified Sol and MedGemma on 30 additional studies, not outcome-selected winner; same frozen prompts/settings
failure_policy: One first diagnostic attempt only. Controller exceptions, timeout, required-tool missing, schema invalid, identity unresolved or wrong case retained as failures; no clinical retries or answer repairs. Infrastructure transport retry only if no clinical action/output occurred, recorded separately.
matched_screenshot_analysis: Optional prespecified first paired case per modality/model if <=4 actual delivered screenshot frames; exact screenshots as B attachments, separate technical sensitivity set. If incompatible or no frames, explicitly not run; not pooled with primary.
decision_policy: No clinical deployment endorsement. Research mechanical completion gate: >=95% valid completion and Wilson lower bound >=80%, clean identity/isolation audit; label clinical conclusions require both classes and wide CIs explicitly. Equivalence not inferred from nonsignificance; exploratory 5pp equivalence margin only if paired 95% CI wholly inside it. MRI binary specificity not estimable. USD ROI not estimable.
report_deadline: 2026-10-01 morning Asia/Kolkata; interim checkpoint report emitted continuously; incomplete assigned cells explicit
